Commentary: Blessing Muzarabani to Mohammad Akram, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Blessing Muzarabani to Mohammad Akram, out Caught by Sikandar Raza!! Mohammad Akram goes. He shadow-practices the forward defence after playing an ugly shot. Hard back of a length into the pitch on off-stump, Akram tries to pull and is in no position at all. High on the bat and a total miscue, it lobs to mid-off for the simplest of catches. Mohammad Akram c Sikandar Raza b Blessing Muzarabani 14(5) [4s-3]
Sediqullah Atal, left handed bat, comes to the crease
Blessing Muzarabani to Sediqullah Atal, no run, short of length and tight on off, Sediqullah Atal goes on the back foot and gets right behind the line to defend to cover
Blessing Muzarabani to Sediqullah Atal, no run, full and angling away from the left-hander outside off, Sediqullah Atal gets forward to drive and picks out extra-cover
Newman Nyamhuri, left-arm fast medium, comes into the attack
Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, short of length just outside off, Ibrahim Zadran gets forward and punches it so nicely, with a high-elbow, but straight to the fielder at short cover

Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, Newman Nyamhuri appeals for a caught behind but there was no bat. Full and angled across Ibrahim Zadran who is late on the drive. He gets forward to play and misses. Past the outside edge

Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, beaten again. This is good bowling by Newman Nyamhuri. Length delivery and angled across outside off, Ibrahim Zadran gets forward to drive and misses. Beaten on the inside edge

Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, 2 runs, length delivery on middle and leg, Ibrahim Zadran jumps out his crease, looks to flick, the thick leading-edge lands short of mid-off where Raza can't stop it to his right. Gives away one more
Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, wide, way outside off, miles outside off and it's left alone. Tadiwanashe Marumani does well to save more runs as he almost stops that near slip
Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, 2 runs, full on middle, Ibrahim Zadran gets forward to flick and mid-wicket is open. Well wide of deep square leg and an easy two
Newman Nyamhuri to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, full on off, Ibrahim Zadran with a nice cover-drive but straight to the fielder at cover-point. Came off the middle of the bat that one
Blessing Muzarabani to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, full outside off, Sediqullah Atal comes down the track to drive and mistimes it in front of mid-off for one
Blessing Muzarabani to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, short of length and top of off, Ibrahim Zadran goes on the back foot and defends in front of cover for an easy single

Blessing Muzarabani to Sediqullah Atal, SIX, thick top-edge and clears Nyamhuri at deep backward square-leg. Hard back of a length into the pitch, Sediqullah Atal goes on the back foot and pulls, the top-edge flies and just clears Nyamhuri

Blessing Muzarabani to Sediqullah Atal, FOUR, what a classical back foot punch that is. Sediqullah Atal is a tall man, he rises even taller and punches the short of length delivery from outside off wide of short cover's right as he dives and then extra-cover's left who doesn't dive. Raced away to the fence. High-elbow and superb timing
Blessing Muzarabani to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, back of a length on middle, Sediqullah Atal goes on the back foot and turns it to the vacant square leg area
Blessing Muzarabani to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, back of a length and nips back in to middle, Ibrahim Zadran goes on the back foot and punches to cover's left. Wants a run but sent back
Newman Nyamhuri to Sediqullah Atal, no run
Newman Nyamhuri to Sediqullah Atal, 2 runs, length delivery outside off, Sediqullah Atal flashes and third man has work to do to his right. He gets there with a dive and cuts it off. Saves two
Newman Nyamhuri to Sediqullah Atal, FOUR, beautiful square-drive. Fullish outside off, Sediqullah Atal gets forward and drives, beats the dive of backward point to his left.
Newman Nyamhuri to Sediqullah Atal, no run, length delivery and sliding down leg, did it brush the thigh pad of Sediqullah Atal?
Newman Nyamhuri to Sediqullah Atal, no run
